questions.Description: Practice on Basic Drawing Skills & Sketching of basic designs–Derby Shoe, coin pouches, key chains, wallets, belts, handbags, skirt, jackets, waist coats & shorts.

Pattern making – basic pattern marking and tracing, developing various patterns of different shapes polygon shapes. - Derby Shoe, coin pouches, key chains, wallets, belts, handbags, skirt, jackets, waist coats & shorts.
Cutting practice – Introduction to cutting and its tools operations.
Manual Cutting Practice for various shapes- paper cutting practice, leather and non-leather practice.
Machine cutting Practice with variable adjustments.
Study of Sewing machine - Flat bed - Cylinder bed - Post bed - Skiving machine - their parts and its function.
Sewing Practice for various shaped lines- paper stitching practice without needle, leather and non-leather practice.
Practice on splitting with variable adjustments.
Practice on skiving with variable adjustments.
Practice on Edge Treatments-Cementing, Folding, Inking &Edge Burning
